source_main: Creely et al. 2020, Overview of the SPARC tokamak, JPP, Sec. 4 / Table 2
hints: H1 POPCON: main ions 85% of n_e, 50-50 D-T
H2 POPCON: 6% helium concentration (fixed; ash inside the 85%), no separate ash model stated
H3 POPCON: tungsten ~1.5e-5, lumped Z = 8 impurity to satisfy quasi-neutrality
H4 POPCON: Z_eff assumed 1.5
H5 POPCON: Te = Ti, nu_T = 2.5
H6 POPCON: n_e peaking = Angioni - 0.1 (ions - 0.2)
H7 nominal: <T> 7.3 keV (Table 2), <n_e> 3.1e20 volume-averaged, n_i 2.7e20, f_G 0.37
H8 nominal: P_fus 140 MW, Q 11.0, P_RF 11.1 MW + P_ohmic 1.7 MW (Q counts ohmic)
H9 radiation = bremsstrahlung + impurity radiation (average-ion model, Jensen 1977); synchrotron not mentioned
H10 P_loss = power through the separatrix (excludes radiation); L-H uses P_ohm + P_aux + P_alpha - P_rad
H11 H98 = 1.0 nominal (0.7 sensitivity)
H12 no central fuelling
H13 (D2201) our engine adds a self-consistent ash (tau_He*/tau_E = 5) ON TOP of the published f_DT
H14 (D2201) Rodriguez-Fernandez 2020 POPCON variant: <T> 7.9 keV, Q 11.2 (different settings, same 140 MW)
H15 (cycle 5) SPARC n0/<n> ~1.3 (TRANSP)
H16 (cycle 5) SPARC P_fus nearly independent of P_ICRH (profile stiffness)
H17 ITER-like ash: tau_He*/tau_E ~ 5 gives n_He/n_e of a few % at Q 10 (ITER FDR 3.2%)
H18 OPEN-ADAS oxygen (Z 8) coronal data available locally (adas/all)
H19 Z_eff from H1-H3 alone at full stripping: 0.85 + 4(0.06) + 64 f_8 + 74^2(1.5e-5) with f_8 = 0.00361 -> ~1.40 (W partly stripped lowers it)
H20 ash fixed vs self-consistent is a modelling choice: compare like with like (the published point fixes it)
